## INTERVAL values and functions
# Sources: BigQuery's interval_functions and data-types#interval_type examples;
# GoogleSQL's compliance/testdata/interval.test (make_interval) and
# compliance/functions_testlib_interval.cc (microsecond cases, NULLs and overflow).

SELECT INTERVAL 25 HOUR
=> "0-0 0 25:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL 6 WEEK
=> "0-0 42 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL 4 QUARTER
=> "1-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL 90 MINUTE
=> "0-0 0 1:30:0"

SELECT INTERVAL 90 SECOND
=> "0-0 0 0:1:30"

SELECT INTERVAL -5 DAY
=> "0-0 -5 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL CAST(NULL AS INT64) DAY
=> null

SELECT CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)
=> null

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL()
=> "0-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(1, 6, 15)
=> "1-6 15 0:0:0"

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(hour => 10, second => 20)
=> "0-0 0 10:0:20"

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(1, minute => 5, day => 2)
=> "1-0 2 0:5:0"

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(second => -6, minute => 5, hour => -4, day => 3, month => -2, year => 1)
=> "0-10 3 -3:55:6"

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(NULL)
=> null

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(year => 1, minute => NULL)
=> null

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(year => 10000, month => 1)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.MAKE_INTERVAL(year => 10000, month => 1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.MAKE_INTERVAL(day => DIV(1, 0))
=> error:

SELECT IF(FALSE, MAKE_INTERVAL(year => 10000, month => 1), MAKE_INTERVAL())
=> "0-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_DAYS(INTERVAL 29 DAY)
=> "0-0 29 0:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_DAYS(INTERVAL -30 DAY)
=> "-0-1 0 0:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_DAYS(INTERVAL 31 DAY)
=> "0-1 1 0:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_DAYS(INTERVAL -65 DAY)
=> "-0-2 -5 0:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_DAYS(INTERVAL 370 DAY)
=> "1-0 10 0:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_HOURS(INTERVAL 23 HOUR)
=> "0-0 0 23:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_HOURS(INTERVAL -24 HOUR)
=> "0-0 -1 0:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_HOURS(INTERVAL 47 HOUR)
=> "0-0 1 23:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_HOURS(INTERVAL -12345 MINUTE)
=> "0-0 -8 -13:45:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_INTERVAL(INTERVAL '29 49:00:00' DAY TO SECOND)
=> "0-1 1 1:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_DAYS(CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL))
=> null

SELECT JUSTIFY_HOURS(CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL))
=> null

SELECT JUSTIFY_INTERVAL(CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL))
=> null

SELECT JUSTIFY_DAYS(INTERVAL 3660000 DAY)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.JUSTIFY_DAYS(INTERVAL 3660000 DAY)
=> null

SELECT JUSTIFY_HOURS(INTERVAL '3660000 24:0:0' DAY TO SECOND)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.JUSTIFY_HOURS(INTERVAL '3660000 24:0:0' DAY TO SECOND)
=> null

SELECT JUSTIFY_INTERVAL(INTERVAL '10000-0 30' YEAR TO DAY)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.JUSTIFY_INTERVAL(INTERVAL '10000-0 30' YEAR TO DAY)
=> null

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "2"

SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "3"

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "4"

SELECT EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "5"

SELECT EXTRACT(SECOND FROM INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "6"

SELECT EXTRACT(MILLISECOND FROM INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "789"

SELECT EXTRACT(MICROSECOND FROM INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "789999"

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM INTERVAL '0-13 370 48:61:61' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM INTERVAL '0-13 370 48:61:61' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM INTERVAL '0-13 370 48:61:61' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "370"

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM INTERVAL '0-13 370 48:61:61' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "49"

SELECT EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM INTERVAL '0-13 370 48:61:61' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "2"

SELECT EXTRACT(SECOND FROM INTERVAL '0-13 370 48:61:61' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM INTERVAL '-22-6 10 -12:30' YEAR TO MINUTE)
=> "-22"

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM INTERVAL '-22-6 10 -12:30' YEAR TO MINUTE)
=> "-6"

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM INTERVAL '10 -12:30' DAY TO MINUTE)
=> "-12"

SELECT EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM INTERVAL '10 -12:30' DAY TO MINUTE)
=> "-30"

SELECT EXTRACT(MILLISECOND FROM INTERVAL -1002003 MICROSECOND)
=> "-2"

SELECT EXTRACT(MICROSECOND FROM INTERVAL -999999 MICROSECOND)
=> "-999999"

SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL))
=> null

SELECT CAST(JUSTIFY_DAYS(INTERVAL 31 DAY) AS STRING)
=> "0-1 1 0:0:0"

SELECT [INTERVAL 25 HOUR, INTERVAL -5 DAY]
=> [{"v":"0-0 0 25:0:0"},{"v":"0-0 -5 0:0:0"}]

SELECT STRUCT(INTERVAL 25 HOUR AS i, CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL) AS n)
=> {"f":[{"v":"0-0 0 25:0:0"},{"v":null}]}

SELECT CAST(ARRAY(SELECT INTERVAL n HOUR FROM UNNEST([25]) AS n)[OFFSET(0)] AS STRING)
=> "0-0 0 25:0:0"

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL), INTERVAL 25 HOUR, MAKE_INTERVAL(year => 10001)) AS STRING)
=> "0-0 0 25:0:0"

SELECT CAST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>) AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>)
=> []

SELECT CAST(INTERVAL 10000 YEAR AS STRING)
=> "10000-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT CAST(INTERVAL -10000 YEAR AS STRING)
=> "-10000-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL 10001 YEAR
=> error:

SELECT INTERVAL '0:0:0.0000001' HOUR TO SECOND
=> error:

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM [CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)][OFFSET(0)])
=> null

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(second => 0.5)
=> error:

SELECT INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789999' YEAR TO SECOND
=> "1-2 3 4:5:6.789999"

# Mixed signs normalize per field, and MAKE_INTERVAL fails on an out-of-range intermediate field
# even when the fields would cancel.
SELECT JUSTIFY_HOURS(MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 1, hour => -1))
=> "0-0 0 23:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_DAYS(MAKE_INTERVAL(month => 1, day => -1))
=> "0-0 29 0:0:0"

SELECT JUSTIFY_INTERVAL(MAKE_INTERVAL(month => 1, hour => -1))
=> "0-0 29 23:0:0"

BEGIN
  SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(year => 9223372036854775807, month => -9223372036854775807);
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  SELECT ENDS_WITH(@@error.message, "int64 overflow: 9223372036854775807 * 12; error in MAKE_INTERVAL expression");
END;
=> "true"

BEGIN
  SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(hour => 9223372036854775807, minute => -9223372036854775807);
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  SELECT ENDS_WITH(@@error.message, "Interval field nanoseconds '32650737010465906356780000000000' is out of range -316224000000000000000 to 316224000000000000000; error in MAKE_INTERVAL expression");
END;
=> "true"

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(year => 10001, month => -12)
=> "10000-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT CAST(INTERVAL -1 MICROSECOND AS STRING)
=> "0-0 0 -0:0:0.000001"
